frameworks.name: NCA ECC
frameworks.description: Saudi Arabia's minimum national cybersecurity requirements. Applies to government agencies, CNI operators, and private sector entities.

controls.title: Cybersecurity strategy defined and approved
controls.description: A comprehensive cybersecurity strategy is documented, approved by leadership, and aligned with organizational objectives.

controls.title: Strategy review and update cycle
controls.description: The cybersecurity strategy is reviewed and updated at least annually or upon significant changes.

controls.title: Cybersecurity objectives and KPIs
controls.description: Measurable cybersecurity objectives and KPIs are defined and tracked.

controls.title: Independent cybersecurity function
controls.description: A cybersecurity function is established independently of IT, with defined authority and resources.

controls.title: Cybersecurity committee
controls.description: A cybersecurity steering committee meets regularly with documented minutes and decisions.

controls.title: Cybersecurity budget allocation
controls.description: Adequate budget is allocated and tracked for cybersecurity initiatives.

controls.title: Cybersecurity reporting lines
controls.description: The cybersecurity function reports directly to executive leadership or the board.

controls.title: Master cybersecurity policy
controls.description: A master cybersecurity policy is approved, communicated, and enforced across the organization.

controls.title: Procedures and standards
controls.description: Supporting procedures, standards, and guidelines are documented and maintained.

controls.title: Policy exception process
controls.description: A formal process exists for requesting, approving, and documenting policy exceptions.

controls.title: Policy communication and awareness
controls.description: Policies are communicated to all relevant personnel and acknowledged.

controls.title: Policy enforcement
controls.description: Violations of cybersecurity policies are addressed through disciplinary action.

controls.title: CISO appointment
controls.description: A Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) or equivalent is appointed with clear responsibilities.

controls.title: Role definitions
controls.description: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities are defined, documented, and assigned.

controls.title: Saudization compliance
controls.description: Cybersecurity roles are filled by qualified Saudi nationals per ECC-2:2024 requirements.

controls.title: Risk management framework
controls.description: A cybersecurity risk management methodology is established and aligned with organizational risk appetite.

controls.title: Risk assessment execution
controls.description: Risk assessments are performed at least annually and upon significant changes.

controls.title: Risk treatment plan
controls.description: Identified risks have documented treatment plans with owners and target dates.

controls.title: Risk register maintenance
controls.description: A risk register is maintained with current risk scores and status.

controls.title: Risk appetite statement
controls.description: A cybersecurity risk appetite statement is defined and approved.

controls.title: Security by design
controls.description: Cybersecurity requirements are integrated into project and change management lifecycles.

controls.title: Security review gates
controls.description: Security reviews are conducted at key project milestones before go-live.

subdomains.name: Compliance with Standards, Laws and Regulations

controls.title: Regulatory inventory
controls.description: Applicable cybersecurity laws, regulations, and standards are identified and tracked.

controls.title: Compliance monitoring
controls.description: Compliance status is monitored and reported regularly.

controls.title: Internal audit program
controls.description: A cybersecurity internal audit program is established with defined scope and frequency.

controls.title: Audit remediation tracking
controls.description: Audit findings are tracked to closure with evidence of remediation.

controls.title: Management review
controls.description: Management reviews cybersecurity performance at planned intervals.

controls.title: Background screening
controls.description: Background checks are conducted for personnel in sensitive cybersecurity roles.

controls.title: Security in employment terms
controls.description: Cybersecurity responsibilities are included in employment contracts and terms.

controls.title: Secure offboarding
controls.description: A process exists for revoking access and recovering assets upon termination.

controls.title: Awareness program
controls.description: A cybersecurity awareness program covers all personnel including contractors and third parties.

controls.title: Role-based training
controls.description: Specialized training is provided based on roles and responsibilities.

controls.title: Training effectiveness measurement
controls.description: Training effectiveness is measured and improvements are implemented.

controls.title: Phishing simulations
controls.description: Regular phishing simulation exercises are conducted with metrics tracked.

controls.title: Asset inventory
controls.description: An accurate inventory of all information assets is maintained with ownership and classification.

controls.title: Asset classification
controls.description: Assets are classified based on confidentiality, integrity, and availability requirements.

controls.title: Asset labeling
controls.description: Assets are labeled according to their classification level.

controls.title: Asset ownership
controls.description: All assets have defined owners responsible for their security.

controls.title: Unique user IDs
controls.description: Unique user IDs are assigned; shared accounts are prohibited except where justified and approved.

controls.title: Access control policy
controls.description: An access control policy defines principles of least privilege and need-to-know.

controls.title: Multi-factor authentication
controls.description: MFA is enforced for all remote access and privileged accounts, and encouraged for all users.

controls.title: Privileged access management
controls.description: Privileged accounts are managed with enhanced controls, monitoring, and justification.

controls.title: Periodic access reviews
controls.description: User access rights are reviewed at least quarterly and upon role changes.

controls.title: Service account management
controls.description: Service accounts are managed with restricted privileges and regular credential rotation.

controls.title: Password policy
controls.description: A strong password policy is enforced across all systems.

subdomains.name: Information Systems and Processing Facilities Protection

controls.title: Secure configuration
controls.description: Systems are hardened using vendor and industry secure configuration baselines.

controls.title: Patch management
controls.description: A patch management process ensures timely application of security updates.

controls.title: Malware protection
controls.description: Anti-malware solutions are deployed, updated, and monitored across all endpoints.

controls.title: Change management
controls.description: Changes to systems are managed through a formal change control process.

controls.title: Secure disposal
controls.description: Systems and data are securely disposed of when no longer needed.

controls.title: Email security gateway
controls.description: An email security gateway filters spam, malware, and phishing at the perimeter.

controls.title: Email encryption
controls.description: Sensitive emails are encrypted in transit and at rest.

controls.title: DMARC/SPF/DKIM
controls.description: Email authentication protocols (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) are implemented and monitored.

controls.title: Network segmentation
controls.description: Networks are segmented to isolate critical systems and limit lateral movement.

controls.title: Firewall management
controls.description: Firewalls are configured with deny-by-default rules and reviewed regularly.

controls.title: Intrusion detection/prevention
controls.description: IDS/IPS systems are deployed and monitored with alert response procedures.

controls.title: Network monitoring
controls.description: Network traffic is monitored for anomalies and security events.

controls.title: Remote access security
controls.description: Remote access is secured with VPN, MFA, and session timeouts.

controls.title: Wireless security
controls.description: Wireless networks are secured with WPA3 or equivalent and segregated.

controls.title: Mobile device policy
controls.description: A mobile device security policy covers BYOD and corporate devices.

controls.title: Mobile device management
controls.description: MDM/EMM solutions enforce security policies on mobile devices.

controls.title: Remote wipe capability
controls.description: Remote wipe and lock capabilities are enabled for lost or stolen devices.

controls.title: Data classification scheme
controls.description: A data classification scheme is implemented with handling requirements per level.

controls.title: Data handling procedures
controls.description: Procedures define how data is created, processed, stored, transmitted, and destroyed.

controls.title: Data loss prevention
controls.description: DLP controls are implemented to prevent unauthorized data exfiltration.

controls.title: Database security
controls.description: Databases are secured with access controls, encryption, and activity monitoring.

controls.title: Data retention policy
controls.description: Data retention and disposal schedules are defined and enforced.

controls.title: Cryptographic policy
controls.description: A cryptographic policy defines approved algorithms, key lengths, and key management.

controls.title: Encryption in transit
controls.description: Sensitive data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.

controls.title: Encryption at rest
controls.description: Sensitive data is encrypted at rest on servers, databases, and storage.

controls.title: Key management
controls.description: Cryptographic keys are managed securely throughout their lifecycle.

controls.title: Backup policy and schedule
controls.description: Backups are performed per defined schedules with retention requirements.

controls.title: Backup testing
controls.description: Backup restoration is tested at least annually with documented results.

controls.title: Offsite/offline backups
controls.description: Critical backups are stored offsite or offline protected from ransomware.

controls.title: Backup encryption
controls.description: Backups are encrypted to protect confidentiality.

controls.title: Backup monitoring
controls.description: Backup jobs are monitored for failures with alerting.

controls.title: Vulnerability scanning
controls.description: Vulnerability scans are conducted at least monthly across all systems.

controls.title: Remediation timelines
controls.description: Critical vulnerabilities are remediated within defined SLAs (e.g., 15 days).

controls.title: Vulnerability tracking
controls.description: Vulnerabilities are tracked in a central register until closure.

controls.title: Penetration test coordination
controls.description: Vulnerability findings are validated and prioritized with penetration testing where needed.

controls.title: Penetration test program
controls.description: Penetration tests are conducted at least annually by qualified independent testers.

controls.title: Remediation of findings
controls.description: Penetration test findings are remediated and verified.

controls.title: Scope coverage
controls.description: Tests cover external and internal networks, web applications, and wireless.

subdomains.name: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management

controls.title: Logging scope
controls.description: Security-relevant events are logged across systems, networks, and applications.

controls.title: Log protection
controls.description: Logs are protected from tampering and unauthorized modification.

controls.title: Centralized log management
controls.description: Logs are aggregated to a centralized SIEM or log management platform.

controls.title: Log review
controls.description: Logs are reviewed regularly with automated alerting for critical events.

controls.title: Log retention
controls.description: Logs are retained per regulatory and operational requirements.

controls.title: Incident response plan
controls.description: A documented incident response plan defines roles, procedures, and escalation paths.

controls.title: Incident response team
controls.description: An incident response team is designated and trained.

controls.title: Incident reporting to NCA
controls.description: Cybersecurity incidents are reported to NCA per regulatory requirements.

controls.title: Incident exercises
controls.description: Tabletop and simulation exercises are conducted at least annually.

controls.title: Threat intelligence integration
controls.description: Threat intelligence is integrated into incident detection and response.

controls.title: Physical access controls
controls.description: Physical access to facilities and critical areas is controlled and monitored.

controls.title: Environmental controls
controls.description: Environmental controls protect equipment from fire, flood, and power issues.

controls.title: Equipment disposal
controls.description: Media and equipment are securely disposed of when no longer needed.

controls.title: Secure development lifecycle
controls.description: Security is integrated into the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

controls.title: Input validation
controls.description: Applications validate and sanitize all inputs to prevent injection attacks.

controls.title: Authentication and session management
controls.description: Applications implement secure authentication and session management.

controls.title: BCP/DR plan for cyber
controls.description: Business continuity and disaster recovery plans account for cyber incidents.

controls.title: Recovery objectives
controls.description: RTO and RPO are defined for critical systems and documented.

controls.title: Plan testing
controls.description: BCP/DR plans are tested at least annually with documented results.

controls.title: Crisis communication
controls.description: Crisis communication procedures are established for cyber incidents.

controls.title: Backup site readiness
controls.description: Alternate processing sites are maintained and tested for readiness.

controls.title: Vendor inventory
controls.description: An inventory of third-party vendors with system/data access is maintained.

controls.title: Vendor risk assessment
controls.description: Security assessments are performed before onboarding critical vendors.

controls.title: Contractual security requirements
controls.description: Cybersecurity and confidentiality clauses are included in vendor contracts.

controls.title: Ongoing vendor monitoring
controls.description: Critical vendors are monitored continuously for security posture changes.

controls.title: Vendor incident notification
controls.description: Contracts require vendors to notify of security incidents within defined timeframes.

controls.title: Cloud security policy
controls.description: A cloud security policy defines approved services, data classifications, and responsibilities.

controls.title: Shared responsibility clarity
controls.description: Cloud shared responsibility model is documented and understood.

controls.title: Cloud configuration security
controls.description: Cloud environments are configured securely with regular posture assessments.

controls.title: Data residency and return
controls.description: Cloud data residency requirements are met with data return arrangements (CCC-2:2024).

controls.title: Cloud exit strategy
controls.description: A cloud exit strategy ensures business continuity if changing providers.

frameworks.name: SAMA CSF
frameworks.description: Cybersecurity framework for the financial sector regulated by SAMA, covering governance, risk management, and technical controls.

controls.title: Cybersecurity governance framework
controls.description: A governance framework defines cybersecurity roles, responsibilities, and oversight.

controls.title: Board oversight
controls.description: The board or equivalent body oversees cybersecurity strategy and risk.

controls.title: Cybersecurity strategy and roadmap
controls.description: A cybersecurity strategy is aligned with business objectives and risk appetite.

controls.title: Cybersecurity risk appetite
controls.description: Cybersecurity risk appetite is defined and approved by the board.

controls.title: Cybersecurity policies
controls.description: Comprehensive cybersecurity policies are approved and communicated.

controls.title: Policy review cycle
controls.description: Policies are reviewed at least annually and upon significant changes.

controls.title: Risk assessment program
controls.description: Systematic risk assessments identify and evaluate cybersecurity risks.

controls.title: Threat intelligence integration
controls.description: Threat intelligence informs risk assessments and prioritization.

controls.title: Risk treatment and acceptance
controls.description: Risks are treated or formally accepted with board approval.

controls.title: Residual risk reporting
controls.description: Residual risks are reported to the board with treatment plans.

controls.title: Security operations center
controls.description: A SOC monitors, detects, and responds to security events 24/7.

controls.title: Security monitoring and alerting
controls.description: Security events are monitored with automated alerting and escalation.

controls.title: Secure architecture
controls.description: Security architecture principles are applied to technology decisions.

controls.title: Secure configuration management
controls.description: Systems are hardened and configurations are baselined and monitored.

controls.title: Third party risk management
controls.description: Third parties are assessed for cybersecurity risk before engagement.

controls.title: Outsourcing security requirements
controls.description: Security requirements are included in outsourcing contracts.

controls.title: Cloud risk assessment
controls.description: Cloud services are risk-assessed before adoption.

controls.title: Cloud security monitoring
controls.description: Cloud environments are monitored for security misconfigurations.

controls.title: Incident detection and reporting to SAMA
controls.description: Incidents are detected and reported to SAMA within defined timeframes (critical: 1 hour, high: 6 hours).

controls.title: Incident classification
controls.description: Incidents are classified by severity with defined response procedures.

controls.title: Incident response capabilities
controls.description: Response capabilities include containment, eradication, and recovery procedures.

controls.title: Post-incident review
controls.description: Post-incident reviews identify lessons learned and drive improvements.

controls.title: Cyber resilience testing

controls.title: Recovery time objectives
controls.description: RTOs and RPOs are defined and tested for critical business functions.

frameworks.name: PDPL
frameworks.description: Saudi Arabia's comprehensive data protection law governing collection, processing, and transfer of personal data.

controls.title: Lawful basis for processing
controls.description: Personal data is processed only with a valid legal basis (consent, contract, legal obligation, vital interests, public interest, legitimate interest).

controls.title: Fair and transparent processing
controls.description: Processing is conducted fairly and transparently with clear privacy notices.

controls.title: Specified and legitimate purposes
controls.description: Data is collected for specified, explicit, and legitimate purposes only.

controls.title: No further incompatible processing
controls.description: Data is not processed in a manner incompatible with the original purpose.

controls.title: Adequate, relevant, and limited data
controls.description: Only data adequate, relevant, and limited to what is necessary is processed.

controls.title: Data accuracy maintenance
controls.description: Personal data is kept accurate and up to date.

controls.title: Retention periods
controls.description: Data is retained only as long as necessary for the processing purpose.

controls.title: Access request process
controls.description: A process exists for data subjects to access their personal data within 30 days.

controls.title: Access request tracking
controls.description: Access requests are tracked and responded to within statutory timeframes.

controls.title: Rectification process
controls.description: Data subjects can request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.

controls.title: Erasure process
controls.description: Data subjects can request deletion of their data when processing is no longer necessary.

controls.title: Objection handling
controls.description: Data subjects can object to processing based on legitimate interests or direct marketing.

controls.title: Restriction of processing
controls.description: Processing can be restricted upon data subject request in defined circumstances.

controls.title: Data portability mechanism
controls.description: Data subjects can receive their data in a structured, commonly used format.

controls.title: DPO appointment
controls.description: A Data Protection Officer is appointed where required by law.

controls.title: Privacy by design
controls.description: Data protection is integrated into processing activities by design and default.

controls.title: DPIA process
controls.description: DPIAs are conducted for high-risk processing activities.

controls.title: DPIA review
controls.description: DPIAs are reviewed and updated when processing changes.

controls.title: ROPA maintenance
controls.description: Records of processing activities (ROPA) are maintained and available to SDAIA.

controls.title: Breach notification to SDAIA
controls.description: Data breaches are notified to SDAIA within 72 hours of discovery.

controls.title: Data subject notification
controls.description: Affected data subjects are notified of high-risk breaches without undue delay.

controls.title: Transfer safeguards
controls.description: Cross-border data transfers use approved safeguards (adequacy decisions, SCCs, BCRs).

controls.title: Transfer impact assessment
controls.description: Transfer impact assessments are conducted for cross-border transfers.

controls.title: TOMs implementation
controls.description: Appropriate technical and organizational measures protect personal data.

controls.title: Security policy for personal data
controls.description: A security policy specifically addresses personal data protection.

controls.title: Encryption of personal data
controls.description: Personal data is encrypted at rest and in transit.

controls.title: Pseudonymization where appropriate
controls.description: Pseudonymization is used where appropriate to reduce risk.
